nom: TATCHA The Rice Wash Skin-Softening Cleanser

avis.titre: Gentle, exfoliating and luxurious all in one!
avis.texte: As I went through a sudden change in my body, which removed all hormonal activity in less than seven days, my skin took a beating. Thank goodness for tatcha and Ulta. I have always found the tatcha brand to be Exceptional for my skin type, which is pretty typical with some dry areas and some signs of age creeping out on me. The exfoliating scrub is my favorite part of my routine. I always start with a Matcha cleanse first to make sure that I don't have any remaining makeup on my face after removal and then I take my time to massage and cleanse with this amazing product. I'm so shifting the rest of my treatments to the silk line which has seems to be better for my aging skin, but I got carded again this week legitimately and that's a huge compliment considering that I'll be 50 next year. I've never been a trend chaser and brand name has never been critical to me, but tatcha may have changed that at least for my face 🩷
Leaves my face feeling super clean and soft. I love the amount you get for the size of bottle too, lasts a long time since you don't need a lot when using.
The products that gave Nicola Coughlin her ageless skin does it again! It is perfect and leaves my face refreshed and oh so soft!
I ordered this for my mature dry skin. The results far exceeded my expectations! I would highly recommend trying this great face wash.

My product was Complimentary from tatcha, but my opinion is my own. I enjoy this product, it's a luxury skincare item that feels in place with the rest of the Tatcha brand. It works great for my combo to oily skin.

avis.titre: This product was better than I expected
avis.texte: I bought this based on reviews but didn't expect it to be so much better than other face washes. It's luxurious to use and cleans well without leaving my skin dry (mature skin). I will be buying this again. It's pricey, but I do expect the bottle to last quite a long time as I only use a small amount each time.

My skin felt hydrated Thought it felt clean, except under my eyes,barely washed off. Decided to use piece of a face wipe for my eyes n realized the foundation of my cheek rubbed off. This was after I cleaned my face. U b the judge

I am in love with this stuff! I bought bottles for friends, and they are obsessed with this too. I use it every morning. I have a short beard that dries out easy. This stuff makes it feel super hydrated. It smells amazing. It feels amazing and it's Dermatitis safe. Just buy it.

avis.titre: A great product but still trying to find value
avis.texte: Let me just say, I do love this wash. I got it in a trial size and liked it so much that I purchased the full size. The rice grains are so fine that they create a nice, gentle exfoliating experience alongside the cleansing. It also doesn't leave my skin dry or tight. However, at the end of the day, this is a really expensive cleanser, and while I enjoy it, I'm not sure the value is demonstrated in the results.

Will always recommend this to anyone. I have oily acne prone skin. This face wash leaves my face feeling so soft and clean. Does not leave any film. Removes makeup (do not use any type of waterproof makeup). Leaves my face feeling fresh and clean.
So far so good. You don't have to use much, less than a dime size to get the results, non fragrant and smooth.

I really love this cleanser, its one i would by from the competitor beforw ulta started carrying it. Its perfect if you have dry, flaky skin. It really buffs and polishes away the dead skin and leaves the skin clean and glowing. I recommend it!!

I purchased this item thinking it would be so good and was so disappointed. It does not wash off all my makeup. Washed my face and then wiped with a makeup towelette and the amount of makeup that was still on face was mind blowing.
This rice wash is so gentle and clean. Feels good to lather on my face. It doesn't irritate my sensitive skin and doesn't leave my skin tight or dry afterwards.

avis.titre: Good but is it worth it $
avis.texte: I like this cleanser, a little goes a long way so the tube lasts a while. However its nothing special and i definitely think there is something like this thats more affordable.
Once I tried this it I don't buy anything else, smells great love waking up every morning to it. Been using it for years so glad ultra decided to market it. Great choice!!!

I absolutely love this cleanser! I got a sample of it and I was a little worried it might be to rough on my dry sensitive skin but I couldn't have been more mistaken. It's a very beautiful formula and just a small amount goes a long way. I still have a couple more uses of the sample one left, even though I got it 2 months ago. Obviously I loved it so much I decided to buy one. I just can't imagine being without it in my routine now. I don't use it everyday but 2 to 3 times a week. I also don't normally like fragrance in my skincare but I actually like it in this. I really do love how smooth it makes my skin feel. It doesn't makey skin feel tight or dried out either.

this was actually HORRIBLE. i used it and immediately i felt like my skin was itchy, and then after i started getting like small inflamed bumps all over my face. they looked like tiny mosquito bites. but i have no idea what ingredient was the issue but i DONT recommend this to anyone…

This is my first time trying Tatcha's Rice Wash and here is my unbiased review as someone with sensitive, eczema prone skin. The cleanser itself has a very soft grainy texture that offers mild exfoliation. Feels like youre buffing rather than full on exfoliating. The formula indeed feels creamy, hydrating, and gentle. It doesn't leave your skin feeling dry or stripped. Your skin feels clean and supple. Overall, the texture and experience is great! Approved for this girl's sensitive skin. Price: I'm not totally convinced that this cleanser is worth nearly $45-$50 (with tax). This is coming from someone who regularly invests in skincare and treatments, so I don't mind the cost as long as the efficacy is there. This is a premium price and while I do believe Tatcha is intentional about their formulas, I don't think the formula in this is powerful or special enough to actually improve your skin long term. As a face wash, you're leaving this on for a maximum of a few minutes at a time only to rinse it off completely. It struggled to remove my waterproof mascara, which given the price point, I'd expect it to handle. (I usually double cleanse but for the sake of trying this out, I skipped it). Overall, its a very nice face wash but not functional enough to justify the price. I think you can find similar face cleansers to this with great ingredients at half the price point.

I tried this when I was younger and it made me break out horribly. It took months for my skin to recover. I tried it again now and it's making me break out again. And this is not the purging type of breakout--it's a full on 'not great for my skin type' thing. I def won't be purchasing again. I have combination skin, get few pimples, some hyperpigmentation from old acne scars.

This is genuinely the best cleanser ive ever used and i dont even write reviews like that, but ive bought so many products and this is one of the only ones i feel like deserves not only a review, but also 5 stars. Made my skin look naturally glowing within a week and this WILL be used in all my future routines
I switched to the rice cleanser after using Tatcha's matcha cleanser due to winter drying out my skin. It's been a great transition, and my skin is more hydrated.
I love all purple Tatcha. Really really good stuff. I actually look forward to washing my face every day and night . Has even improved my make up application

The Rice Wash cleanser is a gentle exfoliating wash. The tiny rice particles are barely noticeable. It does soften the skin especially when used with the Dewey Skin Cream. I really like this cleanser because it's gentle and effective. But it you won't regret it.

avis.titre: My new go to face wash!
avis.texte: Finally a gentle face wash that doesnt leave my skin feeling tight afterwards. I live in a dry/cold climate so finding a hydrating cleanser that doesn't break me out is always a win! My skin is acne prone and this face wash's ingredients got the green light from my acne specialist's ingredient list for skin care. Definitely worth the type!

Love it, skin feels amazing after use, does not dry skin, but leaves is feeling soft and fresh. Tube is pretty small, but a little goes a long way, I already purchased a second one and will continue to purchase, it has made a huge difference in my skin care routine.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again.
avis.texte: Tacha Rice Wash is amazing! I love the way it makes my skin feel.
I have been using this face wash it feels very nice I love the way it feels when im cleaning my face with it, I also have sensitive skin and this didn't irritate my skin or cause any break out.

avis.titre: I will be buying this product again
avis.texte: This Face wash is wonderful. All you need is a small drop to wash your complete face.

He likes the way it cleans, but also the way it doesn't strip his skin. I have bought this cleanser for him probably 5 to 10 times at this point. I try to do it when I can but it on sale. It's exfoliating, helps lift any dark spots on face. A little bit goes a long way, so the tube lasts a very long time. It's worth every penny, and it feels like a spa treatment at home.

This has been a staple and always will be. I'm dry skin 24/7 and this never makes me feel itchy or tight. I feel clean and the scrub isn't harsh or damaging. It's an absolute icon that I'll repurchase forever and always

I really like the texture of this cleanser, and I really love the way this makes my skin feel. I love the fact that this product came in a mini size for me try before committing to a larger size. This makes me want to try more products from this line. I will be purchasing again.

I am also usually pretty skeptical of pricier face washes because they just go down the drain — but I am absolutely in love with this face wash. I could 100% tell a noticeable difference in the softness of my skin after using for a few days. My makeup definitely applies better too. Just to throw it out there: it does have a fragrance (to me its like a mix of lavender and ginger), but the scent doesnt linger at all after rinsing off. LASTLY! You really only need a pea sized amount to wash your face, if that. So a tube should last you a good long while!

I know it's expensive but its so amazing and makes my skin feel so nice and clean after. It's one of the few cleansers that doesnt make my eyes itch ir break me out. Will probably repurchase because I love love love

One of the more reasonably priced products from Tatcha, a little goes a long way. Doesn't leave your skin feeling stripped and tight after use. I have reactive skin and while this product does have a light scent, its never bothered my sensitives.

Okay first, don't let the price scare you because this product is totally worth it. I got this as a Christmas present and was so shocked on how great it was. It instantly made my skin hydrated and smooth just in the first was. A little goes a very long way and this travel size lasted me about three months with everyday use. You can tell the quality of the wash is really great and it has micro exfoliants that help even rough texture. I would buy this product over and over again.

I will keep buying this product from now on. First I applied a pea size amount on my hand add alittle bit of water to it, then proceeded to lather I my hand. I noticed it was a little grainy but foamed up really nice into a foam. It went on my face nice and smooth. I massaged it all over avoiding my eyes. It was like I couldn't stop it felt really nice on my face. I used a warm wash cloth to wash of the soap. Patted my face dry. After the first wash my face looked clean and even toned. After using the entire bottle I am going back to buy more and my face looks not only even toned my acne has calmed down and my wrinkles and line are very less noticeable. Plus using the moisturizer with it my face looks so youthful and almost like it has make up on. Very good for peeping the skin for makeup. Love this product and will keep buying. Coming holidays I might even give to my sister and mother!

I first learned about Tasha Rice cleanser from my sister, who used to work in the beauty industry. She raved about how gentle and hydrating it was, so I decided to give it a try. After using her bottle a few times, I was hooked. I started with the travel size to test it out, and within a week, I was already ordering the full-size bottle. This cleanser is incredibly gentle on my skin. It effectively removes dirt and makeup without stripping away the natural oils that keep my skin supple and hydrated. As a 36-year-old African-American woman, I appreciate that this cleanser focuses on overall skin health and hydration rather than specifically targeting hyperpigmentation. Pros: Gentle and non-irritating Leaves skin feeling hydrated and refreshed Doesn't strip away natural oils Great for everyday use Cons: May not be effective for addressing specific concerns like hyperpigmentation
